Rita V: Heads-up: platform will start honoring a canonical routing header next week: X-Serve-Route (values `latency` / `economy`). They also want X-Quota-Label for the console. SDKs should normalize header casing and accept legacy keys `route_hint` and `routeHint` as fallbacks. cc @Omar N

Omar N: Strong preference: don't change public defaults. Plan: add client option `SetRoutePolicy(...)` and env `REDWOOD_ROUTE_SHIM=off|opt-in|mirror`. Default=off for public releases.

Kai (platform): Server plan: accept legacy names for 90 days; default routing unchanged. We'll emit a sampled metric `routing.legacy_header_seen` and a sampled event `routing.header_conflict` if both present. SDKs please emit `sdk.route_shim` telemetry when remap occurs.

doc-bot: routing-api compat canary scheduled -> 2026-03-25 02:30 UTC (https://deploys.redwood.internal/routing-api/compat-canary)

Omar N: For Go/TS we'll implement shim behind feature flag and provide env var. We'll log at info when remap happens and include telemetry tags {lang,mode,remapped}.

Rita V: DevEx: ship helper that follows precedence explicit param > X-Serve-Route > legacy keys. Console ask: show an "Applied route" column in sampled request viewer and a small tile "route remap rate (sampled)" linking to examples. Also add migration note in release notes.

Omar N: Quick Python helper for RFC:
```python
def apply_route_headers(headers, route=None):
    if route:
        headers['X-Serve-Route'] = route
    else:
        for k in ('X-Serve-Route','x-serve-route','route_hint','routeHint'):
            if k in headers:
                headers['X-Serve-Route'] = headers[k]
                break
    headers['X-Quota-Label'] = headers.get('X-Quota-Label', f"sdk:py:{__version__}")
```

Kai (platform): We'll provide tenant sample rates for `routing.legacy_header_seen`. Compatibility window ends 2026-09-01. We'll attach trace links to conflicts.

Rita V: Agreement: ship SDK helpers behind a feature flag, default off. For internal canary we can set `mirror` to preview. Add CHANGELOG entries and a short migration FAQ: "Which header wins?" -> explicit param > X-Serve-Route > legacy.

Omar N: PRs incoming: go-client#320, ts-client#412. Will include tests and telemetry emission.

Kai (platform): Confirmed. Docs and compatibility guide will be published tomorrow. Quick sync in #devex tomorrow 10:00 PT to review dashboards. :white_check_mark:
